title: Commercial Lease Application
summary: Choose from 100 commercial lease applications for 20 business uses. Preview 1–4-page forms with matching PDF, Image, Word, and ODT downloads.
lead: Find the right application for your business use, operating stage, and level of detail.
usage_paragraphs: The PDF contains fillable application fields. Word provides editable structured fields, while ODT is an editable OpenDocument text layout. Editable versions may render differently depending on your office application and fonts.
The Image download contains every page in one full-resolution image. Use the page buttons above to inspect the individual pages before downloading.
Complete the fields relevant to the proposed premises and identify the records requested by the recipient. These are application forms; proposed terms require a separate lease.
selection_guide: Start with Business Use, then choose how much information the recipient needs. Essential is a one-page introduction. Standard adds operations, authority, rental history, a financial summary, and supporting records.

Startup focuses on a new business or organization, launch funding, projections, and management experience. Established includes three fiscal years of results, year-to-date figures, current tenancy, and references. Comprehensive expands the premises requirements and review across four pages.

All applications use US Letter portrait pages. Color designs appear first, followed by black-and-white designs. The preview and description show the actual contents and page count for each application.

title: Dog Vaccination Record
summary: Browse 100 dog vaccination record designs in color and black-and-white. Choose puppy, adoption, clinic, travel, booster, reaction, or long-term formats, with fillable PDF, editable Word, and static Image files.
lead: Choose a record for routine care, a new puppy, clinic visits, travel planning, or a dog’s longer history.
usage_paragraphs: These are personal record-keeping forms. Copy dates and product details from records supplied by your veterinary practice, and ask the clinic to confirm which entries apply to your dog.

Travel organizers help keep trip details together but do not replace official veterinary certificates, rabies documentation, or destination requirements. Confirm current travel requirements with your veterinarian and the relevant authorities.

Each design includes a fillable PDF, an editable Word document, and a static Image file. Word documents are arranged to fit one page in the checked LibreOffice render; edits or another office app may change pagination.
selection_guide: Start with the record type that matches the handoff or routine: puppy, adoption, foster, boarding, training, travel, booster, reaction follow-up, appointment, or longer-term history. The form fields vary by purpose, so review the preview before downloading.
Choose US Letter or A4, portrait or landscape, and color or black-and-white. The travel organizer is for notes and preparation only; it is not an official health or travel certificate.

title: Tournament Bracket
summary: Choose from 100 seeded single-elimination tournament brackets for 4 to 64 teams. Download PDF, Image, Word, or Excel files in color or black-and-white.
lead: Choose your team count and bracket layout, then record each result on the path to a champion.
usage_paragraphs: Enter participants in the seeded opening positions and carry each winner into the connected next-round box. A bye advances a participant without a played game.

The fillable PDF and static Image preserve the supplied printable layout. Word offers an editable bracket. Excel uses Setup for seeded names and Results for scores, then automatically advances winners to Bracket. Equal scores require an A or B tie-winner choice.
selection_guide: Choose the number of participants first. Brackets with 6, 10, 12, or 24 teams include byes to complete the opening round.
Choose a visual layout and color or black-and-white treatment. Preview the full page before downloading, particularly for the denser 32- and 64-team brackets.

items.title: 4-Team Stadium Trophy Bracket
items.summary: A central trophy separates the two sides of the bracket under a bold stadium-style heading. This 4-team single-elimination layout uses navy with cyan and gold accents.
items.intro: A central trophy separates the two sides of the bracket under a bold stadium-style heading. This 4-team single-elimination layout uses navy with cyan and gold accents.
items.alt: 4-team stadium trophy tournament bracket in navy with cyan and gold, with seeded match boxes and a champion space.
description_paragraphs: Enter the 4 participants in the seeded opening positions, then write each winner in the connected box for the next round. The path ends at the champion box after 2 rounds and 3 played games. Every opening position has an opponent, so no first-round byes are needed.

A central trophy separates the two sides of the bracket under a bold stadium-style heading. This US Letter landscape version uses navy with cyan and gold styling with event, date, and venue spaces. Use the fillable PDF or static Image for a printable bracket, or edit the bracket in Word. In Excel, enter names on Setup and scores on Results; formulas advance winners to the Bracket sheet. For tied scores, choose A or B as the tie winner.

title: Printable Protractor
summary: Browse 100 printable protractor designs, including semicircular, full-circle, compass, corner, drafting, and polar layouts. Download matching PDF and Image files in US Letter or A4.
lead: Choose an angle scale and page layout, then print and check the scale before measuring.
usage_paragraphs: Choose the scale for the job: a semicircle for a half turn, a full circle for a complete turn, a compass layout for clockwise bearings from north, or a corner layout for a quadrant.

Use the downloaded PDF for measurement printing. Match its stated paper size and orientation, select 100% / Actual Size, and turn off Fit to Page. Verify both sides of the 20 × 20 mm control square with a ruler before measuring.
selection_guide: Choose the instrument type first. Ruler-base, window, and fine-scale layouts use semicircular scales; full-circle and compass layouts cover a full turn. Polar layouts add rings and radial guides.

Drafting sets combine several instruments, twin layouts offer two semicircular tools, and half-and-full sets combine a semicircle with a disc. Then choose US Letter or A4, portrait or landscape, and color or black-and-white.
For overlay work, use suitable tracing paper or carefully trim an open-window design while preserving its center, baseline, and degree scale. White areas printed on ordinary paper remain opaque.

print_note.title: Print at Actual Size
print_note.intro: Check the printed scale before measuring.

steps.title: Match the Page
steps.text: Open the downloaded PDF and select the paper size and orientation stated on the page.

steps.title: Use 100% / Actual Size
steps.text: Turn off Fit to Page, Shrink, and other automatic scaling. Actual Size prints without changing the page scale.

steps.title: Check Both Sides
steps.text: Measure the horizontal and vertical sides of the 20 × 20 mm control square with a ruler. Both must be 20 mm. If either differs, correct the print settings and reprint before measuring.

title: 90-Day Employee Evaluation
summary: Explore 100 employee evaluation forms for first-quarter reviews, feedback, readiness, and next steps. PDF and Word contain the complete form; each Image shows the first page.
lead: Choose a review format for the conversation, evidence, and next steps that matter to your team.
usage_paragraphs: Start with the employee and review details, then use the prompts to record specific observations, work examples, and agreed next steps. Choose a form suited to the role and the purpose of the review.
PDF and Word contain the complete form. The Image is the first page only. Google Docs is supplied as a downloadable shortcut to the online document and may require a Google account and access.
selection_guide: Choose a review focus and the page length that fits your discussion. Short forms cover an individual conversation; longer packets provide space for more evidence and follow-up.
Color forms appear first; use Print Style to select black-and-white layouts. The preview shows the first page, while the PDF and Word downloads contain the complete form.
